resources.string: Reads text on your screen (Telegram, X/Twitter, any app) and shows an English translation of Russian and Chinese text directly on top of it. Translation runs fully on your device; nothing is sent to any server.

Screen Translate

Translates Russian and Chinese text on your screen into English, in place, in any app.

Setup:
1. Download the language packs (once, ~30 MB each).
2. Enable "Screen Translate" in Accessibility settings.

Using the floating 文A button:
• Tap = translate the screen now (tap again to show the original)
• Long-press = switch AUTO mode on/off (green = auto)
• Drag = move the button
